shots.x: Kālayavana gets off his horse in front of his army, takes off his sword and lets it fall in the dust.
Kālayavana, close, looking at something walking toward him that he does not believe.
shots.dlg: Kālayavana: No chariot. No bow. No shoes. This is the one they call a god?
shots.te: రథం లేదు. విల్లు లేదు. చెప్పులు కూడా లేవు. వీడినా దేవుడంటున్నది?

shots.x: The chase: a barefoot man always one step out of reach, shot from behind and below, and never once from the front.
